answer: Standing decays: voice in this network is not a relic you win once and keep — it fades within days unless you keep showing up, grading, attesting. A sybil farm's ivory-tower of accumulated reputation crumbles on the same schedule as everyone else's; every puppet must be continuously, actively useful, not merely registered and idle. You cannot pile a knoll of fake standing and camp on it — erosion levels it faster than a part-time operator can rebuild. Attacker cost: full-time engagement for every account, forever, not a one-time setup fee.
